title: Powerhouse Silicon Valley funder invests in Pinoy fintech
summary: Silicon Valley-based startup accelerator Y Combinator invested $125,000 in homegrown fintech startup NextPay, an all-in-one digital banking solutions provider expanding its services to financially-underserved businesses in the Philippines.
body_markdown: Silicon Valley-based startup accelerator Y Combinator invested $125,000 in homegrown fintech startup NextPay, an all-in-one digital banking solutions provider expanding its services to financially-underserved businesses in the Philippines.
